description: We're a team of 4 (IOI & RMI Silver Medalists, Physics Olympiad winner, ISET & Komarovi builders) skilled in full-stack dev, AI, data, finance, and pitching. Passionate about turning bold ideas into real products across any industry, we've won BTU Agro-Innovation, placed at GITA, reached SAGE Finals, and launched BeMentor. Join a fast, proven team built to execute and win! We welcome creative thinkers, designers, or builders with any standout skill to complement our roster.
